extracted.intended_audience: Users of PARI/GP and computational number theorists (developers writing code that manipulates number fields)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for PARI/GP library routines operating on number fields: what each function computes, required argument formats, return formats, flags, and important caveats and examples. Intended to guide correct usage and understand limitations of each routine.

rubrics_metrics.name: ideallog
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the discrete logarithm of an element x on the generators given in bid.gen for the finite abelian group (ZK/D)*. x must have valuation 0 at primes in the support of D. Returns vector (xi) with 0 ≤ xi < di such that x ≡ ∏ g_i^{x_i} (mod *D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: when D contains infinite places, congruence implies sign conditions on real embeddings. See znlog for algorithmic limitations. When nf omitted, nf = Q and x must be t_INT and bid from idealstar(,N). Syntax: ideallog(nf = NULL, x, bid). Also Zideallog(bid,x) when nf is NULL.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealmin
rubrics_metrics.description: (Deprecated) Computes a pseudo-minimum of ideal ix in direction vdir in number field nf; kept for backward compatibility. Use idealred instead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: vdir optional; use idealred for modern usage. Syntax: idealmin(nf, ix, vdir = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealmul
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiplies ideals x and y in nf producing HNF ideal product; extended ideals [I,t] are updated so [I,t]*[J,u] → [IJ, tu], and I*[J,u]→[IJ,u].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If flag ≠ 0, reduce the result using idealred. Syntax: idealmul(nf,x,y,{flag=0}); also idealmul0 for flag. Examples show multiplying integral ideals and extended ideals; see idealmulred for automatic reduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealnorm
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the norm of ideal x in number field nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: idealnorm(nf,x). Returns integer norm.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealnumden
rubrics_metrics.description: Given x in nf returns [A,B] integer ideals, coprime, with x = A/B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: idealnumden(nf, x). Example: idealnumden((x+1)/2) returns numerator and denominator ideals in HNF.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealpow
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes k-th power (k ∈ Z) of ideal x in nf; extended ideal [I,t] raised to k gives [I^k, t^k].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If flag ≠ 0, reduction via idealred is applied throughout binary powering (different from post-reduction). Syntax: idealpow0(nf,x,k,flag). See idealpow, idealpows, and idealpowred (flag=1 behavior).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealprimedec
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes prime ideal decomposition of positive rational prime p in number field K represented by nf. Optionally restrict to primes of residue degree ≤ f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns vector of prid structures pr = [p, a, e, f, mb] where a is algebraic integer with valuation 1 at the prime, e ramification index, f residue degree, mb multiplication table for uniformizer computations. Access components via pr.p, pr.e, pr.f, pr.gen. If f present non-zero restricts to primes with residue degree ≤ f. Syntax: idealprimedec(nf,p,{f=0}). Caveat: undefined input for non-prime p.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealprincipalunits
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a prime ideal pr (in prid format), returns (1+pr)/(1+pr^k) as an abelian group: much faster than idealstar for large norm primes because it avoids residue field multiplicative group work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns group structure with cyc and gen fields. Syntax: idealprincipalunits(nf, pr, k). Example shows group cyclic components and minimal generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealramgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: For Galois field K/Q (nf) with gal=galoisinit(nf) and prime ideal pr in prid format, returns vector g of subgroups: g[1]=decomposition group, g[2]=inertia group G0(P), and for i≥2 g[i]=G_{i-2}(P) (higher ramification groups).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Length equals number of non-trivial groups. Use card(H) helper to get subgroup cardinalities. Syntax: idealramgroups(nf,gal,pr). Examples demonstrate cardinalities and using resulting subgroup to compute fixed field discriminant; notes about behavior when inertia trivial.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealred
rubrics_metrics.description: LLL-reduces ideal I in nf along optional direction v to find a ∈ K* such that J = (a)I is 'small' and integral; returns HNF of J (or extended [J, sa] if input extended).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: v should be nf.r1+nf.r2 vector of non-negative integers; relative magnitudes matter. Can be used as a quick test for principality (non-trivial result doesn't prove non-principal). Technical notes: uses a rescaled rounded norm form; element a is first LLL vector. Syntax: idealred0(nf,I,v=NULL). See bnfisprincipal for guaranteed principality tests. Caveats: algorithmic heuristics and coefficient growth; idealpow referenced for factoring representations.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealstar
rubrics_metrics.description: Outputs a bid structure describing the finite abelian group G = (ZK/N)* for modulus N in nf; bid contains bid.mod, bid.clgp, bid.no, bid.cyc, bid.gen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: flag controls content: flag=1 (default) returns bid without generators (saves time); flag=2 includes generators; flag=0 returns only the abelian group as [h,d,g]. If nf omitted, take Q and N integer. Alternate faster wrappers: znstar for Q. Prefer Idealstar with bitwise flags nf_GEN and nf_INIT. Syntax: idealstar0(nf=NULL,N,flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealtwoelt
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes two-element representation of ideal x in nf: returns [a, α] with x = a ZK + α ZK. Default chooses a as positive generator of x∩Z (unless x principal -> a may be 0); randomized polynomial-time algorithm. If a provided, assumes a ∈ x and returns α such that x = aZK + αZK (slower due to factoring a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: idealtwoelt0(nf,x,a=NULL). Also idealtwoelt and idealtwoelt2 variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealval
rubrics_metrics.description: Gives valuation of ideal x at prime ideal pr (pr in idealprimedec format). Valuation of zero ideal is +∞.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: gpidealval(nf,x,pr). Also available long idealval(nf,x,pr) returning LONG_MAX for x=0.

rubrics_metrics.name: matalgtobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Deprecated: apply nfalgtobasis to each entry of a vector/matrix x for nf; use apply instead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: matalgtobasis(nf,x). Use apply for modern code.

rubrics_metrics.name: matbasistoalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Deprecated: apply nfbasistoalg to each entry of x; use apply instead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: matbasistoalg(nf,x). Use apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: modreverse
rubrics_metrics.description: Given z = Mod(A,T) (polmod) with minimal polynomial Q satisfying deg(Q)=deg(T), returns reverse polmod Mod(B,Q) which is a root of T; useful to change generating element in algebraic extensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converts between different polynomial presentations of same field and gives explicit isomorphisms. Fails if minpoly degree < expected with domain error. Syntax: modreverse(z). Examples show changing defining polynomials and converting elements between representations.

rubrics_metrics.name: newtonpoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns vector of slopes of Newton polygon of polynomial x with respect to prime p; components in decreasing order; vertical slopes (if constant coefficient 0) denoted +∞.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: newtonpoly(x,p).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfalgtobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Transforms algebraic number x in nf to column vector on integral basis nf.zk (inverse of nfbasistoalg).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: algtobasis(nf,x) (aliases). Examples: transforms algebraic elements and polmods into basis coordinates.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given integral irreducible polynomial T(X) returns an integral basis (Z-basis of maximal order) of number field Q[X]/(T). Supports optional listP to request maximality at given primes or set of primes/integers to target Buchmann-Lenstra behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses modified Round 4 algorithm. listP may be vector of primes, factorization matrix, or integer B (primes up to B). Can produce local p-maximal bases. Include caveats about factoring field discriminant D and composite entries in listP (allowed if pairwise coprime); examples and recommended B≈1e5. Use nfcertify to certify correctness. Syntax: nfbasis(T, *d, listP=NULL) returning basis and optional discriminant *d.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfbasistoalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Converts column vector on integral basis to t_POLMOD algebraic element (inverse of nfalgtobasis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: basistoalg(nf,x). Examples given.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfcertify
rubrics_metrics.description: Given nf (from nfinit), checks whether integer basis nf.zk is known unconditionally (especially useful when nfinit used [T,listP]). Returns vector of coprime composite integers; empty vector means nf.zk and nf.disc are correct unconditionally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If non-empty, factor each integer, addprime their prime factors, and verify nfdisc(nf.pol) equals nf.disc to obtain certified result. Syntax: nfcertify(nf). Example: nfinit([T,B]); nfcertify(nf) => [] means certified.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfcompositum
rubrics_metrics.description: Given nf for K and squarefree polynomials P,Q in K[X], returns simple factors R of the étale K-algebra A = K[X,Y]/(P(X),Q(Y)) as polynomials R in K[X] (each defines a number field K[X]/(R)), sorted by increasing degree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer to reduce P,Q to irreducible factors first. flag binary bits: 1 includes [R,a,b,k] with expressions of roots; 2 assumes P,Q irreducible and linearly disjoint to save factorization over K and return single factor. Main variables must obey var priority rules (see varhigher/varlower). Syntax: nfcompositum(nf,P,Q,flag). Example shows computing compositum and then reducing polynomial representation with rnfpolredbest.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfdetint
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a pseudo-matrix x, computes a non-zero ideal contained in (a multiple of) its determinant; useful with nfhnfmod.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfdetint(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfdisc
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes discriminant of number field defined by integral irreducible polynomial T using Round 4 algorithm. Supports listP like nfbasis to get discriminant of an order maximal at specified primes or p-adic discriminant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfdisc(T) with optional listP. Use padicdisc(T,p)=p^valuation(nfdisc(T,[p]),p). Caveats same as nfbasis: conditional nfinit([T,listP]) may require nfcertify. Examples provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltadd
rubrics_metrics.description: Adds two elements x and y in nf (x+y).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfadd(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdiv
rubrics_metrics.description: Divides two elements x and y in nf returning quotient x/y.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfdiv(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdiveuc
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes an algebraic integer q such that components of x - qy are reasonably small; functionally identical to round(nfdiv(nf,x,y)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfdiveuc(nf,x,y). Useful for obtaining nearest integer quotient.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdivmodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Obsolete: computes quotient x/y modulo prime ideal pr (modpr format). Use nfmodpr instead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This function is normally useless in library mode; prefer projecting to residue field. Syntax: nfdivmodpr(nf,x,y,pr).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdivrem
rubrics_metrics.description: Given x,y in nf returns [q,r] with x = qy + r, q an algebraic integer and r with reasonably small components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfdivrem(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmod
rubrics_metrics.description: Given x,y returns r = x - qy with q algebraic integer such that r is small (same as x - nfmul(nf, round(nfdiv(nf,x,y)), y)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfmod(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmul
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiplies x and y in nf yielding x * y.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfmul(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmulmodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Obsolete: computes product x*y modulo prime ideal pr (modpr format). Use nfmodpr and factorff instead by projecting to residue field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfmulmodpr(nf,x,y,pr). Not useful in library mode.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltnorm
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns absolute norm of x ∈ nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfnorm(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltpow
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes x^k for integer k (positive or negative) in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfpow(nf,x,k). Aliases: nfinv(nf,x) for k=-1 and nfsqr(nf,x) for k=2.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltpowmodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Obsolete: computes x^k modulo prime ideal pr; use nfmodpr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfpowmodpr(nf,x,k,pr). Prefer projecting to residue field.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltreduce
rubrics_metrics.description: Given ideal id in HNF and element a of nf, finds r ∈ nf such that a - r ∈ id and r is small.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfreduce(nf,a,id). Useful for canonical small representatives modulo ideals.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltreducemodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Obsolete: compute canonical representative for class of x modulo pr (modpr format); use nfmodpr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfreducemodpr(nf,x,pr). Prefer projecting to residue field using nf to Fq.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfelttrace
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns absolute trace of x ∈ nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nftrace(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltval
rubrics_metrics.description: Given x in nf and prime ideal pr (idealprimedec format), computes valuation v_pr(x). Valuation of 0 is +∞. If &y provided, sets y = x * τ^v where τ is anti-uniformizer (valuation -1 at pr, 0 at other primes dividing pr.p), so y is part coprime to pr and algebraic integer if x was.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: gpnfvalrem(nf,x,pr,*y=NULL) or long nfvalrem(nf,x,pr,*y). Useful to factor exponent vectors and obtain coprime factors to map to residue field efficiently. Examples show usage to extract coprime part y.

rubrics_metrics.name: nffactor
rubrics_metrics.description: Factors univariate polynomial T over number field nf (coefficients in nf); returns factors sorted by increasing degree. Handles polmod, polynomial, vector coefficients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Main variable of nf must be of lower priority than that of T. Can input defining polynomial instead of nf structure (less efficient). Algorithm: Belabas variant of van Hoeij, polynomial-time. Caveat: if nf was constructed conditionally via nfinit([T,listP]) ensure nfcertify or use nf.pol to avoid missing factors. Syntax: nffactor(nf,T).

rubrics_metrics.name: nffactorback
rubrics_metrics.description: Given factorization f (and optional exponent vector e), returns the nf element corresponding to the factorization (product of factors f[i]^e[i] or f[i] if e omitted). Integer 1 corresponds to empty factorization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nffactorback(nf,f,e=NULL). Example reconstructs algebraic integer from factorization description.

rubrics_metrics.name: nffactormod
rubrics_metrics.description: (Obsolete: use nfmodpr and factorff) Factor polynomial Q modulo prime ideal pr (pr in idealprimedec or modprinit format), lifting coefficients to nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Main variable priority rules apply. Precomputing nfmodprinit for pr speeds up ~10%. Syntax: nffactormod(nf,Q,pr). Prefer nfmodpr + factorff and working directly in residue field for modern use.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfgaloisapply
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies Galois automorphism aut of nf (given by image on field generator or in basis form) to object x (element or ideal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: aut can be given in different representations; providing automorphism in basis form is faster if used repeatedly. Beware: applying automorphism to prime ideals may yield representations not equal under direct equality test (representations differ even if underlying ideals equal). Syntax: galoisapply(nf,aut,x). Examples show performance difference between aut representations.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfgaloisconj
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes conjugates of root r of polynomial nf.pol expressed as polynomials in r; returns Q-automorphisms (and can be adapted to K-automorphisms via rnfgaloisconj wrapper).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: flag parameter historically supported but flag=0 (combination of 4 and 1) is recommended. flag=1 uses nfroots (slower but polynomial-time guaranteed); flag=4 uses galoisinit (fast but only for many Galois fields). Optional d is multiple of common denominator. Use galoisconj(GEN nf, GEN d) in modern usage. Syntax: galoisconj0(nf,flag,d,prec) or galoisconj(nf,d). Examples and recipe shown for K-automorphisms computation.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfgrunwaldwang
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs polynomial (coeffs in nf) defining cyclic extension of minimal degree meeting local conditions at given primes and real places: at primes Lpr[i] local degree multiple of Ld[i]; at real places pl[i]=-1 enforces complex place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Degree is LCM of local degrees; current search restricted to prime powers and construction to primes due to rnfkummer restrictions. If nf lacks n-th roots of unity triggers bnf(nf(ζ_n)) computation which may be costly. For nf=Q allow prime integers as primes (primality not checked). Syntax: nfgrunwaldwang(nf,Lpr,Ld,pl,{v=variable_number}). Example constructs quadratic extension satisfying specified local behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfhilbert
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes global quadratic Hilbert symbol (a,b) in nf: returns 1 if x^2 - a y^2 - b z^2 has nontrivial solution in nf, -1 otherwise; if pr provided computes local symbol at prime ideal pr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfhilbert0(nf,a,b,pr=NULL). Also: nfhilbert(bnf,a,b) (global) variant.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfhnf
rubrics_metrics.description: Given pseudo-matrix (A,I) finds pseudo-basis (B,J) in Hermite normal form of generated module; if flag non-zero also returns transformation matrix U such that A U = [0 | B].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: nfhnf0(nf,x,flag). Use nfhnf(nf,x) for flag=0. rnfsimplifybasis(bnf,x) simplifies pseudo-basis making ideals integral, primitive, trivial or non-principal.
